1. The 2dsphere index is built on the S2 library. S2 projects a cube onto the sphere and splits each face recursively into four child cells, down to 31 levels (0–30). A level-30 leaf cell is about 1 cm across. https://s2geometry.io/devguide/s2cell_hierarchy.html 2. Each S2 cell has a 64-bit `S2CellId` ordered along a Hilbert space-filling curve. Cells whose ids are close together are also close together on the sphere. https://s2geometry.io/devguide/s2cell_hierarchy.html 3. Index versions 1–2 stored cell keys as strings. Version 3 (MongoDB 3.2) switched to 64-bit `NumberLong` keys. SERVER-19072
